title: PyTorch 2.8: PYTHONPATH no longer respected when building from source?
bug_description:
### 🐛 Describe the bug

I'm trying to add PyTorch 2.8.0 to Spack in https://github.com/spack/spack-packages/pull/985. However, the build seems to be failing due to the following error message:
```
  [2015/7188] Generating /tmp/root/spack-stage/spack-stage-py-torch-2.8.0-suiy653mjbbyhxjaoauyoshqnyybjtim/spack-src/torch/utils/data/datapipes/datapipe.pyi
  FAILED: [code=1] /tmp/root/spack-stage/spack-stage-py-torch-2.8.0-suiy653mjbbyhxjaoauyoshqnyybjtim/spack-src/torch/utils/data/datapipes/datapipe.pyi
  cd /tmp/root/spack-stage/spack-stage-py-torch-2.8.0-suiy653mjbbyhxjaoauyoshqnyybjtim/spack-src && /home/software/spack/__spack_path_placeholder__/__spack_path_placeholder__/__spack_path_placeholder__/__spack_path_placeholder__/__spack_path_placeholder__/__spack_path_placeholder__/__spack_path_placeholder__/__spack_path_placeholder__/__spack_path_placeh/linux-x86_64_v3/cmake-3.31.8-ax4ks6rznxx344rrs6fac4lawb6kq4dc/bin/cmake -E env PYTHONPATH="/tmp/root/spack-stage/spack-stage-py-torch-2.8.0-suiy653mjbbyhxjaoauyoshqnyybjtim/spack-src/torch/.." /home/software/spack/__spack_path_placeholder__/__spack_path_placeholder__/__spack_path_placeholder__/__spack_path_placeholder__/__spack_path_placeholder__/__spack_path_placeholder__/__spack_path_placeholder__/__spack_path_placeholder__/__spack_path_placeh/linux-x86_64_v3/python-venv-1.0-ltcoct26osiwtnrfoilomx7pk7v237bh/bin/python3 /tmp/root/spack-stage/spack-stage-py-torch-2.8.0-suiy653mjbbyhxjaoauyoshqnyybjtim/spack-src/torch/utils/data/datapipes/gen_pyi.py
  Traceback (most recent call last):
    File "/tmp/root/spack-stage/spack-stage-py-torch-2.8.0-suiy653mjbbyhxjaoauyoshqnyybjtim/spack-src/torch/utils/data/datapipes/gen_pyi.py", line 6, in <module>
      from typing_extensions import deprecated

However, `typing_extensions` is in my `PYTHONPATH` and has always worked previously. My best guess is that `PYTHONPATH` is being overwritten somewhere and can no longer be used to specify dependencies, but I could be completely off the mark.
